title: Concrete Pump Hose vs Steel Pipe
seoTitle: Concrete Pump Hose vs Steel Pipe | Pinjin Parts
description: ACI 304.2R: a given length of hose needs about three times the pressure of the same length of steel, and 1 m hose ≈ 3 m pipe equivalent. Pinjin quotes delivery pipe and delivery hose by pump model. Long runs should be steel; hose is the placing end.
primaryKeyword: concrete pump hose vs steel pipe

answerBlock.what: Steel delivery pipe is the long, rigid line. Rubber placing hose is the flexible end. ACI 304.2R notes that roughly three times more pressure is required through a given length of flexible hose than through the same length of steel, and cites ACPA: 1 m of rubber hose ≈ 3 m of pipe equivalent. Pinjin lists straight delivery pipes and delivery hoses, both quoted by pump model, DN and length — no size table, no list price, no small-batch parcels. DN80 clamps are marked EN14420-3 / PN10/16.
answerBlock.who: Crews laying a long trailer pipeline who want to run hose the whole way, or buyers ordering ‘some rubber pipe’ without a DN.
factors: Printed pump distance is not a hose-only budget
ACI/ACPA equivalent length for hose and elbows
Quote pipe and hose after model + DN + length
Remove hose from service when the lining shows reinforcement braiding (ACPA)

faqs.question: Can I use rubber hose for the whole pumping distance?
faqs.answer: ACPA/ACI: for long distance, use steel for as much of the run as practical; hose at the placing end. A metre of hose is not a metre of steel (about 1 m hose ≈ 3 m pipe equivalent in the ACPA note cited by ACI 304.2R). Pinjin catalogue distances are not ‘hose-only’ guarantees.

faqs.question: Does Pinjin publish hose and pipe diameters on the parts pages?
faqs.answer: Delivery pipe and delivery hose pages do not print a fixed DN/length table. Diameter and length are quoted after the pump model. The DN80 clamp page is labelled EN14420-3, DN80, PN10/16, 3″/89. Other diameters are quoted against the pipeline. Electric 20 lists 80 mm pipe; Electric 15 and the mixer pump list 100–125 mm / 100 / 125 mm.

faqs.question: When should a placing hose be taken out of service?
faqs.answer: ACPA mechanics guidance: remove hose when the inside lining wears enough to show reinforcement braiding. Pinjin does not publish a replacement-hour table. Photograph the lining with the model slug when you inquire.
